executions.cypher: MATCH (sender:Account {acct_no: $acct_no, _workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(recipient:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})<-[:OWN]-(owner:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) RETURN DISTINCT owner.id AS owner_id ORDER BY owner_id ASC LIMIT $limit

MATCH (source:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})-[:TRANSFER]->(target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) MATCH (target)-[:OWN]->(owner {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) RETURN DISTINCT owner.id AS owner_id ORDER BY owner_id ASC LIMIT $limit
MATCH (start:Account {acct_no: $acct_no, _workspace_id: $workspace_id})<-[:TRANSFER*1..2]-(upstream:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT upstream.id) AS count LIMIT $limit
MATCH (start:Account {acct_no: $acct_no, _workspace_id: $workspace_id})<-[:TRANSFER*1..2]-(upstream:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT upstream) AS count LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a1:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(p:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})<-[:OWN]-(a2:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}), (a1)-[:TRANSFER]->(a2) WHERE a1.id <> a2.id RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT [a1.id, a2.id]) AS count LIMIT $limit

operators.details: NOT anon_1 = anon_0 AND a1:Account AND a1._workspace_id = $workspace_id AND NOT cache[a1.id] = cache[a2.id]
